_note: 2_S02 'Small Offenses' — the Hattrick house-vandalism mission (per the correction at the top of docs/re-notes/ch2/2_S02-small-offenses.md: the canonical name 'Small Offences' belongs to 2_S07; this script is the scrapped-PS2-remnant Hattrick mission whose name SE reused — script id stays 2_S02). Galloway's revenge errand: tail Mr. Hattrick home, slip into his yard before the gate locks, smash his property while the cops pile up outside, then slip back out (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_S02-small-offenses.md). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-S02 cutscene is a title card + Galloway speech beat (no Galloway spawn — no DAT point for him); the clock is forced to 18:30 like the original's meeting; **the car tail is a foot tail** — no NPC-driven vehicles yet (vehicle_tail/scripted_vehicle_arrival from the gap table are pending), so Hattrick runs the _2_S02_FROMSCHOOL route (gait sprint — the original's governor tops out at 12 m/s, so a sprint is the honest stand-in) and the 70 m fall-behind fail is our leash (70 m held 5 s; the original is an instantaneous 3D check); the car-damage and stand-on-car fails go away with the car; the arrival NIS (driveway pull-in, door sounds) is a speech beat; the indoor/outdoor Hattrick swap is a despawn; the destruction meter is EIGHT stand-in target dummies at the trigger file's own yard-area points (the ~140 trich_* breakables are name-hash world props we cannot drive — same posture as 1_04's window targets; the weighted 2/3-point costs, the 0/80 meter and its bark/music escalation ladder collapse into one wave counter); the two sirened cop-car arrivals compress to two stationary cop NPCs as dressing (busts were never this mission's Lua concern — punishment owns them, OPEN in the recon); the yard is a box approximation of the yard polygon for the leave-early fail (a 3 s exit countdown that cancels on re-entry, vs the original's instant trigger-exit fail); the escape pass is a reach beat on the street (trigger_exit exists but the smoke driver has no exit-drive yet — leave-zone passes stay reach beats until it does); Hattrick's storm-out chaser conversion IS real (a hostile one-member wave hunting the player during the escape). No SMissPass case and no in-script reward (VERIFIED absence) — a pure story beat. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.

lines.speaker: GALLOWAY
lines.text: Hattrick had me suspended, the pompous old goat. Follow him home, slip into his yard, and break everything he owns. I'll make it worth your while.

Tail Hattrick home. Don't lose him.
